valid_fixes: Change 'loc' back to 'location' as the key in the message body JSON in csv-to-sqs.py so the consumer's body['location'] reference resolves correctly
invalid_patches: Change sqs-to-dynamodb.py to read body['loc'] instead of body['location'] — propagates the schema rename into the database key but does not fix the schema contract
Add a try/except around body['location'] to silently skip failed rows — hides the error without writing records
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_invoke_lambda(function=CSVProcessingToSQSFunction) → inspect event structure to confirm sent message shape
ace_get_log_tail(function=CSVProcessingToSQSFunction) → parser succeeds; compare sent JSON keys to confirm 'loc' vs 'location' mismatch
observable_symptom: The parser runs successfully and messages appear in the work queue. The consumer function is invoked but every invocation throws KeyError: 'location'. Messages exhaust retries and accumulate in the dead-letter queue. No records are written to the database.
root_cause: The CSV parser serializes the location field using the key 'loc' in the JSON message body, but the consumer handler reads body['location']. Every invocation of the consumer raises KeyError: 'location', causing all messages to fail and route to the DLQ after maxReceiveCount retries.
